paite: Huan kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
heading: Kumpipa'n Isai Ngaihdan Adong / (Isa 37.1-7)
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

paite: Inn sung heutu Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh siampu upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

paite: Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh salhna leh minsiatna ni ahi. Naute lah apian uh ahunta ngal a, piangsak ding in lah thahatna a-om nawnta ngal kei.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.

paite: Apu Assuria kumpipa'n Pathian hing gense ding a asawl Rabshakeh thugen tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian in aza dia, athugen, TOUPA na Pathian in athu azak in ana sal kha mai ding, huaiziak in, a-om lai khosuaksunte thumsak in," achi va chi un.
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah sikhate Isai kiang ah ahoh uh.
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

paite: Isai in akiang uah, "Na pu kiang ah huchi in gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Assuria kumpipa sikhate'n kei ahon gensiatnate uh, na zak thute ziak in lau mawk ke'n.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master this: ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

paite: Ngai in, asung ah kha ka omsak ding a, thuthang aza ding a, ama gam ah apai nawn ding. Huchi in ama gam mahmah ah namsau puksak in ka omsak ding, achi hi,' chi in," achi hi.
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

paite: Huchi in Rabshakeh akik nawn a, Assuria kumpipa'n Libna khua ana sual lai amu a; Lakish a pan apawt chih azaksa him ahi.
heading: Assuriate'n Vaulauna Dang Asawl Nawn Uh / (Isa 37.8-20)
english: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

paite: "Ngai in, nang hon dou ding in apawtta," chi a Tirhak Ethiopia gam kumpipa tungtangmi gen ana zak in Hezekiah kiang ah mite asawl hi.
english: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you,” he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,

paite: Hichi in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah na gen ding uh, "Na Pathian na muan in Jerusalem khua Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in hon khem kei hen.
english: “Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

paite: Ngai in, Assuria Kumpipate'n gam tengteng ahihse vek ua, atung a athilhih uh na za a; nang humbit na hi tuan dia hia?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?

paite: Namte pathiante'n ka pi-le-pute'n ahihmangte uh ahumbit ua hia? Gozan, Haran, Reseph, Eden ta Thelasar a omte.
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

paite: Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim khopi kumpipa, Hena kumpipa, Ivah kumpipate koi a om ahita ua? chi in,” achi hi.
english: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

paite: Hezekiah in amisawlte khut a pan lai amu a, asim a: Hezekiah TOUPA' inn ah alut a, TOUPA ma ah huai aphalh hi.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

paite: Hezekiah TOUPA ma ah athum a, "TOUPA aw, cherubte tung a tu, Israel Pathian, nang, nang kia leitung gam tengteng Pathian na hi a; lei leh van nangmah siamsa ahi uh.
english: Hezekiah prayed before Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

paite: TOUPA aw, na bil na doh inla, ngai dih ve; TOUPA aw, na mit hak inla, en dih ve; Pathian hing gense dia Sennakerib in thu ahong gen ngaikhe dih ve.
english: Incline your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to defy the living God.

paite: TOUPA, Assuria kumpipate'n namte leh agamte uh ahihse ngei ua, apathiante uh mei ah apai uh.
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,

paite: Hiaite pathian ahi kei him ua, mihing khut a bawl sing leh suang ahi zaw uhi. Huaiziak in mei a pailut in ahihmang uhi.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they have destroyed them.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA, ka Pathian uh aw, nang, nang kia TOUPA Pathian na hi chih leitung a lalgam tengteng in atheihtheihna ding un akhut a pan hon humbit in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”

paite: Huai lai in Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, TOUPA Israel Pathian in hichi in achi: Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib siatna ding a ka kiang a na thum ka za, chih gen ding in mi asawl hi.
heading: Kumpipa Kiang A Isai Thugen / (Isa 37.21-38)
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘You have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, and I have heard you.

paite: Amah tungtang TOUPA'N agen hiai ahi: "Zion tanu nungak siangthou in nang hon musit in, ahon nuihsan a; Jerusalem tanu in alu hon sinkhum hi.
english: This is the word that Yahweh has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

paite: Kua na minsesak a, kua na gensia a? Kua tung ah ahia na aw na sansak a, na mit na hah sang? Israelte Mi Siangthoupa tung ah ahi.
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!

paite: Na misawlte zang in TOUPA na minsesak a, ka kangtalai tampi toh Lebanon gamgi tang sangte ka hong tungtouta hi. Huai a sidar sing sang pipite leh taksing hoih pipite ka phuk dia; alei hoihna mun gammang a tenna mun ngil pen ah ka lut ding.
english: By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.

paite: Gamdang tui ka laikhia a, ka dawn zel a, ka khepek nuai ah Aigupta lui tengteng ka kangsak vek ding, na chi hi.
english: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”

paite: "Keimah in nidanglai a pan huai ka hih ahihdan bang, ma lai a pan huai ka bawl ahihdan bang na za kei a hia? Khokulh neite in chinkhawm lel bang a hihsepa ding in nang ka hon septa hi.
english: Haven’t you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.

paite: "Huaiziak in asung a omte'n hatna anei kei ua, alauthawng ua, ahong zahlakta uhi. Gamlak loupa bang leh loupa hing bang leh intung a loupa bang leh buh alet ma a haivuai bang ahi uhi.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops and like grain blasted before it has grown up.

paite: "Ke'n bel na tut, na lut, na pawt leh ka tung a na hehnate ka thei hi.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

paite: Ka tung a na heh ziak leh uangtak a na pau ka bil a ahong luttouh ziak in ka nakbulh na nak ah ka bulh dia, ka sikbah na muk ah; na hong kuanna lampi mahmah ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding," chi in.
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’

paite: "Hiai nang a dia chiamtehna ahi ding. Tukum in buhsang na sen ding ua; kum nawn chiang in asang mah; kum thumna ah buh na tuh ding ua, at unla, grephuante bawl unla, agahte ne un.
english: “This will be the sign to you: This year, you will eat that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

paite: Huchi in Judah inkote lak a khosuaksunte'n asuklam in zung akai ding ua, atoulam in agah nawn ding uhi.
english: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

paite: Jerusalem a pan a omsunte Zion tang a pan akhosuaksunte apawtkhe ding uhi. TOUPA phatuamngaihna in hiai ahih ding," achi hi.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. Yahweh’s zeal will perform this.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria kumpipa tungtang thu huchi in agen: "Hiai khopi ah ahong tung kei ding, hiai ah leng thal akap sam kei ding, lum toh akiang ah lah ahong pai kei ding a, akhozul ah lah lei ase sang kei ding hi.
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

paite: Ahong kuanna lampi ah, huai mah ah anungkik nawn dia, hiai khopi ahong tung kei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

paite: "Kei ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi humbit ding in ka veng ding," chi in.
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for my servant David’s sake.’”

paite: Huchi in huai zan in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel akuankhia a, Assuriate giahphual ah mi nuaikhat singgiat-le-sangnga athat a; zingkhang a ahong thoh uleh, ngai in, misi luang ngen ana om maimah hi.
english: That night, Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib apawt a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Nineveh ah a-omta hi.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh.

paite: Apathian Nisrok inn a amah abiak lai in hichi ahong hi a, Adrammelek leh Sarezerte'n namsau in athat ua; huchi in Ararat gam ah atailutta uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Esarhaddon alalta hi.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
